text.en: 1. This Act may be cited as the Finance Act 1991.

2. The Income Tax Act 1967, the Supplementary Income
Tax Act 1967, the Petroleum (Income Tax) Act 1967, the
Customs Act 1967, the Sales Tax Act 1972, the Service
Tax Act 1975 and the Excise Act 1976 are amended in the
manner specified in Chapters I], III, IV, V, VI, VII and
VIII respectively.

CHAPTER II
AMENDMENTS TO THE INCOME TAX ACT 1967

3. (1) Except for sections 7, 10, 11 (a), 11 (b), 19, 20 (5),
21, 23, 26, 27, 28 (d) and 28 (e), this Chapter shall have

effect for the year of assessment 1991 and subsequent
years of assessment.

(3) Sections 7, 10, 11 (a), 11 (b) and 26 shall have effect

(4) Sections 21, 28 (d) and 28 (e) shall be deemed to
have come into force on the Ist October 1989.

4. The Income Tax Act 1967, which in this Chapter is
referred to as the "principal Act", is amended by deleting
section 3A.

12. Section 45 of the principal Act is amended—

(a) by substituting for subsection (2) the following:

"(2) Where an individual and a wife of his
were living together in the basis year for a year

other, then the wife may elect in writing before
the first day of April in the year of assessment or
any subsequent date (as may be permitted by the
Director General) in the year of assessment that
her total income shall be aggregated with the
total income (if any) of her husband and assessed
in his name for that year of assessment:

Provided that where a wife is not resident for
the basis year for a year of assessment, she may
elect under this subsection only if she is a
citizen."; and
